name: Anima Charged
desc:
Anima Charged
-Your next Magic ability is empowered:
- Sonic Wave: Your next Magic ability costs 35% less Adrenaline.
- Dragon Breath: Deals 260%-310% Magic damage.
- Concentrated Blast: Each attack grants an additional 10% Critical Strike Chance.
duration: 15 seconds or until casting one of the affected abilities
trigger: Activating Runic Charge
effects:
* Causes Sonic Wave to reduce the adrenaline cost of the next Magic ability by 35% rather than 10%
* Causes Greater Sonic Wave to reduce the adrenaline cost of the next Magic ability by 45% rather than 20%
* Causes Dragon Breath to deal 260%-310% damage rather than 110%-130%
* Causes Concentrated Blast and Greater Concentrated Blast to grant an additional 10% Critical Strike Chance

name: Anticipation
desc:
Anticipation
Focus your mind to anticipate incoming attacks.
- Reduce all damage taken by 10%.
- Immune to stuns.
- 10.2s duration.
duration: 10.2 seconds
trigger: Activating the Anticipation ability
effects:
*Reduces all damage taken by 10%
*Grants immunity to stuns

name: Balance by Force
desc:
Balance by Force
Strike your target with an arrow of pure anima.
duration: 30 seconds
trigger: Activating Balance by Force, the Bow of the Last Guardian's special attack (or used with Essence of Finality)
effects: Reduces the number of stacks of Perfect Equilibrium needed to trigger its effect from 8 down to 4

name: Barricade
desc:
Barricade
Summon an impenetrable dome of shields.
- Prevent all damage received.
- 4.8s-10.2s duration based on the level of shield equipped.
duration: 4.8-10.2 seconds or until the current shield/defender is unequipped
trigger: Activating the Barricade ability
effects:
*Prevents all damage received
*Duration increases with the level of the equipped shield/defender

name: Berserk
desc:
Berserk
Go berserk, empowering yourself.
duration: 20.4 seconds
trigger: Activating the Berserk ability
effects:
*Increases melee damage dealt by 75%
*Increases all damage taken by 25%
*Doubles Bloodlust stacks generated by basic abilities
*Increase the maximum Bloodlust stacks to 8
*Reduces Overpower cooldown to 9 seconds

name: Bloated
desc:
Bloated
Swollen from the inside.
duration:
* 18 seconds
* Removed upon activating Freedom or eating numbing root
trigger: Applied to targets hit by the Bloat ability
effects:
* 25% of initial damage per hit every 1.8 seconds (maximum of 10 hits to the initial target).
* On-death: Applies Bloated with the same damage to up to nine enemies within one game square for four hits.
* May spread to further enemies on death even from the target that wasn't the primary target of Bloat.

name: Bloodlust
desc: Bloodlust
duration:
* Until consumed by affected abilities
* Removed by some teleports
trigger:
* Activating any basic Melee ability, except for Bladed Dive, grants 1 stack
* Activating Rend grants 2 stacks
* Activating Berserk grants 4 stacks, and whilst active causes basic abilities to grant twice the usual number of stacks
* Maximum of 4 stacks
** Increases to 8 stacks during Berserk
effects:
* Activating Assault consumes 4 stacks, causing the damage to be increased from 130%-150% damage to 170%-190% damage
* Activating Hurricane consumes 4 stacks, causing it to deal another instance of 75%-95% damage to the target and up to 9 additional targets
* Activating Flurry or Greater Flurry consumes 4 stacks, causing them to deal 1% increased damage for each 1% Life Points the target is missing, up to a maximum of 65%

name: Chain
desc: The next ability cast on the primary target is also cast at Chained targets.
duration: 6 seconds
trigger:
* Applied to the primary target hit with Chain or Greater Chain
* Cannot be applied in PvP
effects:
* The next ability cast on the primary target will also be cast on the secondary targets hit by Chain or Greater Chain, with varying damage reduction dependent on ability and Caroming perk level.
** Chain: 30%
** Greater Chain: 50%
** Caroming: +5% + 5% per rank, i.e. +25% at rank 4

name: Channelled Might
desc:
Channelled Might
- Your Magic attacks gain +[number]% Critical Strike Damage.
duration:
* 3.6 seconds
* If wearing 5 pieces of Tumeken's resplendence equipment, 9 seconds
trigger: Casting Asphyxiate for its full duration.
effects:
* Increases critical strike damage by 15%.
* If wearing 5 pieces of Tumeken's resplendence equipment, increases critical strike damage by 35%.

name: Chaos Roar
desc:
Chaos Roar
Release a savage war cry, empowering your next strike.
duration: 7.2 seconds
trigger: Landing an attack with the Chaos Roar ability
effects: Increases the base damage of the next ability hit by 75% (25% in PvP)

name: Combust
desc:
Combust
Explode the target, causing them to burn.
duration:
*Combust: 18 seconds
*Blazer: 6 seconds
*Dragon Breath: 3.6 seconds
*Removed upon activating Freedom or eating numbing root
trigger:
*Applied to targets hit by the Combust ability
*Up to a 50% chance to be applied to targets hit with magic with the Ring of kinship equipped with the Blazer class selected
*10% chance to be applied to targets hit by Dragon Breath while Dragon Rider amulet equipped
effects:
Combust:
*Deals 27%-33% ability damage every 1.8 seconds (maximum of 5 hits)
*Causes Dragon Breath to deal 1.25 damage
Blazer:
*Deals 500 damage every 1.2 seconds (maximum of 5 hits)
*If a target is affected by the Combust ability and Blazer effect, only Combust damage is taken
Dragon Breath:
*Deals 18.8% ability damage every 1.2 seconds (maximum of 3 hits)
*Stacks with the Combust ability

name: Conflagrate
desc:
Conflagrate
- Your next Combust within 15s deals 40% increased damage.
duration: 15 seconds
trigger: Activating Soulfire, the Roar of Awakening's special attack (or used with Essence of Finality)
effects: Your next Combust within 15 seconds deals 40% increased damage.

name: Corruption Blast
desc:
Corruption Blast
Blasts the target with corruption, causing them to take damage over time.
duration:
*Primary target: 6 seconds
*Secondary target: inherits the duration from the status of the ally it spread from
*Removed upon activating Freedom or eating numbing root
trigger:
*Applied to targets hit by the Corruption Blast ability
*Applied to targets within 2 squares of an ally that has at least 1 hit of the status remaining
effects:
*Deals damage every 1.2 seconds (maximum of 5 hits)
*First hit deals 33–100% of the user's ability damage
*Subsequent hits deal 80%, 60%, 40%, and 20% of the first hit respectively
*Spreads to allies within 2 squares, inheriting the remaining number of hits and reduced damage

name: Corruption Shot
desc:
Corruption Shot
Corrupts the target, causing them to to take damage over time.
duration:
*6 seconds

effects:
*Deals damage every 1.2 seconds (maximum of 5 hits)
*First hit deals 33-100% of the user's ability damage
*Subsequent hits deal 80%, 60%, 40% and 20% respectively

name: Death Essence
desc:
Death Essence

- Touch of Death, Finger of Death, Death Skulls: Immediately readies Death Spark
duration: 30 seconds
trigger: Activating Death Essence, the Weapon Special Attack of the Omni guard
effects: Activating Touch of Death, Finger of Death, or Death Skulls causes Death Spark to be readied

desc:
Death Spark
- At 5 stacks your Basic Attack is empowered and deals 2x damage.
duration: |effects = While Death Spark is ready, the Necromancy basic attack is empowered and deals double damage, consuming Death Spark.
trigger:
* Activating Necromancy basic attack while wielding the Omni guard grants one stack.
* At 5 stacks Death Spark is readied.
* Activating the Death Essence special attack readies Death Spark.
* For 30 seconds after activating Death Essence, Touch of Death, Finger of Death and Death Skulls immediately ready Death Spark.

desc:
Death's Swiftness
Create a shroud of death.
duration:
*30 seconds

effects: Increases ranged damage by 50%

name: Debilitate
desc:
Debilitate
Perform a debilitating kick to the target.
- 20%-100% ability damage.
- Reduce the damage taken from the target by 50%.
- 7.8s-13.8s duration based on the level of shield equipped.

trigger: Activating the Debilitate ability

Devotion
Empower yourself with the protection of the gods.
- Increase the effectiveness of your protection prayers to 100%(75% in PvP).
- 9.6s duration.
- Killing an enemy extends the duration by 4.8s up to a maximum of 19.2s.

*9.6 seconds
*Can be extended by 4.8 seconds by killing an enemy (can only occur twice, maximum total duration: 19.2 seconds)
trigger: Activating the Devotion ability
effects:
*The effectiveness of protection prayers and deflect curses is increased to 100% (damage reduced to 1)
*In PvP, effectiveness is increased to 75%

name: Devour Active
desc: Devour Active - All healing is half as effective.
duration: 10 seconds
trigger: Applied to targets hit by Devour, Obliteration's special attack (or used with Essence of Finality)
effects: Halves the amount of life points restored by most form of healing

desc:
Dismember
Slice at the target causing them to bleed.
duration:
*9.6 seconds
*Removed upon activating Freedom or eating numbing root
trigger: Applied to targets hit by the Dismember ability
effects:
*Deals 25%-35% of the user's ability damage every 1.2 seconds (maximum of 5 hits)
*Heals you for 4% of the damage dealt.

Dismember
Your Dismember ability is empowered and can be recast.
duration: 24 seconds
trigger: Activating Dismember or Slaughter
effects: Allows Slaughter or Massacre to be cast, respectively

name: Divert
desc:
Divert
Channel power into your shield to block an attack.
- Block the next attack.
- 6s duration.
- Generate 0.8% adrenaline for every 100-200 damage blocked, based on the level of shield active with diminishing returns at 3,000, 6,000 and 9,000 damage blocked.
- Powerful attacks will have their damage blocked, but will not generate adrenaline.
duration: 6 seconds or until consumed or until the current shield or defender is unequipped
trigger: Activating the Divert ability
effects:
* Reduces the damage from the next attack that deals more than 1 damage to 1
* Grants adrenaline based on the damage blocked and tier of the equipped shield or defender
** Defenders are treated as a shield of half their level
* Soft typeless damage is blocked but does not grant adrenaline

name: Dragon slayer
desc: Dragon slayer - Boosts your damage against dragons by 15%.
duration: 10.2 seconds
trigger: Activating the Dragon Slayer ability
effects: Increases damage dealt to susceptible dragons by 15%

duration: Indefinite

effects:
* Damage dealt by player who applied the debuff to the subject of the debuff, while wielding an Ek-ZekKil, will be increased by 12%.
* Damage taken by the player who applied the debuff from the subject of the debuff, while wielding an Ek-ZekKil, will be decreased by 12%.

Flow

Freedom
Break free from all that stops you.
- Remove stuns and binds.
- Clear damage over time effects.
- Gain immunity to stuns and binds.
- 6s duration.
duration: 6 seconds
trigger: Activating the Freedom ability
effects:
*Initially, clears most stun, bind and bleed effects
*Grants immunity to stuns and binds

desc: Golden Touch - All alchable items (under your loot beam value) that drop for the next 60 seconds will be automatically high-alched
duration: 60 seconds

effects: All alchable items that drop with a value under your loot beam value will automatically be high-alched

duration:

effects: Casting Greater Barge will grant the Endless Assault buff for 6 seconds (your next melee channelled ability is a applied as a damage over time effect)

Guthix's Blessing
Invoke a butterfly that heals you.
- Heal 8% of your Life Points every 1.8s.
- 9.6s duration, unless the butterfly is destroyed by enemies.
duration:
*9 seconds
*Removed upon moving away from the butterfly
*Removed if the butterfly is killed
trigger: Standing by the butterfly spawned by activating the Guthix's Blessing ability
effects: Heals 8% of the user's maximum life points every 1.8 seconds

name: Haunted
desc:
Haunted
- Takes up to [number]% bonus damage from all attacks, capped at [number] damage.
duration: 3.6 seconds
trigger: Applied with every attack of a commanded Vengeful Ghost
effects:
Every hit to that target deals up to 10% extra damage, with the extra damage capped at 20% of the commanding player's ability damage.

If applied by a player with The Devourer's Nexus equipped:

Every hit to that target deals up to 15% extra damage, with the extra damage capped at 30% of the commanding player's ability damage.

name: Ice Asylum
desc:
Ice Asylum
Summon a healing crystal.
- Heal anyone near the crystal for 1%-7% of their maximum Life Points every 3.6s.
- Healing percentage is based on proximity to the crystal.
- The crystal has a capacity of 300% of your maximum Life Points.
- 22.2s duration, or until the crystal capacity is drained.
duration:
*21.6 seconds
*Removed if the crystal capacity is drained
trigger: Activating the Ice Asylum ability
effects:
*Upon activation, creates a crystal nearby
**Heals any nearby players for 1-7% of their maximum life points every 3.6 seconds
**Healing decreases with distance from the crystal
**The crystal has a capacity 300% of your maximum life points
**Ironman Mode players may only be healed by their own crystal

name: Immortality
desc:
Immortality
Show tenacity even in the face of death.
- Reduce all damage taken by 25%.
- 30s duration.
- If you die during this period, immediately return to life with 40% of your maximum lifepoints.
- The damage reduction effect is removed upon returning to life.
duration: 30 seconds or until death or until the current shield/defender is unequipped
trigger: Activating the Immortality ability
effects:
*Reduces damage taken by 25%
*If the user dies, return to life with 40% of their maximum life points

Lesser Purifying Light
- 45%-55% Melee damage to up to 2 additional enemies within 4 tiles of the target.
duration: 30 seconds
trigger: Using the Sunfall Slam special attack of the Tumeken's Light
effects:
Every melee ability causes up to 2 projectiles to travel from the primary target of the ability to other enemies within 4 tiles of the primary target.

Abilities which hit secondary targets will not cause additional projectiles to spawn.

Channelled abilities such as Assault will spawn projectiles on each hit, unless they are affected by Greater Barge.

Multi-hit abilities such as Hurricane and Slice & Dice will not spawn additional projectiles.

name: Limitless

name: Necrosis

Necrosis
An overwhelming sense of death.

Max stacks: 12
duration:

* Certain teleports clear all the stacks.
trigger:
* Activating the Touch of Death ability grants four stacks.
* Activating Necromancy auto attack under the effect of Living Death grants two stacks.
* The passive effect of the occultist's ring grants Necromancy attacks a 10% chance to generate two stacks with each cast.
effects:
* Enhances Finger of Death by reducing its adrenaline cost by 10% per necrosis stack, consuming up to six stacks.
* Enhances the Death Grasp special attack by dealing an additional 40% Necromancy damage per stack, consuming all stacks.

name: Phantom Guardian
desc:
Phantom Guardian
Protects against harm.
- Reduces damage taken from core damage types by up to 5%, capped at [number] (10%).
- Generates 1 Valour stack with each incoming hit.

Maximum stacks: 25.
duration: 60 seconds
trigger: Activating Conjure Phantom Guardian
effects:

** This reduced damage is depicted as a blocked damage hitsplat on the Phantom Guardian with a cyan background and a shield icon
* Tracks stacks of valour whilst the Phantom Guardian is conjured.
* Activation of Command Phantom Guardian consumes all stacks of valour and deals an additional 20% damage to the player's opponent for each stack.

name: Primordial Ice
desc:
Primordial Ice

Maximum stacks: 10.
duration: 2 minutes from gaining a stack or until consumed by activating Icy Tempest. This includes reaching the maximum of 10 Primordial Ice stacks, due to the inability to gain more stacks.
trigger: Chance to gain a stack with each attack cast with a dark ice shard (5% chance), dark ice sliver (1% chance), Dark Shard of Leng (10% chance), or Dark Sliver of Leng (2% chance), or their augmented or dyed variants, up to 10 stacks. Melee bleeds cannot generate stacks.
effects:
* Increases the damage of Icy Tempest by 18%–22% ability damage per stack.
* Reduces the adrenaline cost of Icy Tempest by 12% per stack.
** Removes adrenaline cost completely with at least 3 stacks.
** Adrenaline requirement is unchanged.
* If a dark ice sliver or Dark Sliver of Leng is equipped, gain Frostblades when gaining a stack of Primordial Ice.

name: Provoke

Provoke
Taunt the target.

Reprisal
Use the targets power against them.

*6 seconds

Residual Soul
The remains of a soul harvested from an enemy.

Max Stacks: [3/5]
duration:
*Until the Soul Strike or Volley of Souls abilities are cast, or the Devourer's Guard special attack Soul Crush is used
*Six seconds outside of combat

*Casting the Spectral Scythe and Soul Sap abilities
*The passive effect of Zorgoth's soul ring grants Necromancy attacks a 5% chance to generate a residual soul with each cast.
*Upon reaching 4 stacks of Soul Reave, the passive effect of the Devourer's Guard, the next Necromancy basic attack generates one residual soul.

*For Soul Strike, a residual soul is used for:
**135%–165% necromancy damage.
**Stun and Bind target for three seconds.
**90%–110% necromancy damage to enemies within a tile of the target.
*For Volley of Souls, two to five residual souls are used for:
**135%–165% necromancy damage for each residual soul stack.
* For Soul Crush, two to five residual souls are used for:
**135%–165% base necromancy damage plus 135%–165% additional damage for each residual soul stack.
**Soul Sap, Soul Strike, Volley of Souls and Spectral Scythe immediately ready Soul Reave for the next 30 seconds.
**Immediately readies Soul Reave.

Resonance
